segments.text: In today's video we are going to talk about the basic color code of electrical power cable.

segments.text: So let's start the video.
segments.zh: 那我们开始吧。

segments.text: Friends, the electrical power cable is the basic color code.
segments.zh: 朋友们，电力电缆有基本的颜色代码，

segments.text: So what you know about it is very important.
segments.zh: 所以了解它是非常重要的，

segments.text: So today we are going to know this.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们就来了解一下。

segments.text: So as you can see here that the face conductor is a line.
segments.zh: 你们在这里可以看到，相线导体就是火线，

segments.text: The second is like a neutral conductor.
segments.zh: 第二种是中性导体，也就是零线，

segments.text: And the third is a protective conductor i.e. the earth line.
segments.zh: 第三种是保护导体，也就是地线。

segments.text: So the line of the face conductor, you should know which color code is used for the power cable.
segments.zh: 那么相线导体的线，你应该知道电力电缆用的是哪种颜色代码。

segments.text: So first of all, this face conductor line.
segments.zh: 首先是这个相线导体的线，

segments.text: So in this, the line of the single face and the line of the three faces, you know what its color code is.
segments.zh: 这里面有单相的线和三相的线，你要知道它的颜色代码是什么。

segments.text: So first of all, you know about the single face.
segments.zh: 首先，你来了解一下单相。

segments.text: So the line of the single face can be red color or yellow color or blue color i.e. the line comes in this color.
segments.zh: 单相的线可以是红色、黄色或蓝色，也就是这根线是这几种颜色。

segments.text: Now we know the power cable of the three faces, so what is the color code of it?
segments.zh: 现在我们来了解三相电力电缆，它的颜色代码是什么呢？

segments.text: So the power cable of the three faces, there are three lines in it.
segments.zh: 三相电力电缆里有三根线。

segments.text: So line 1 is of red color i.e. the wire is of red color.
segments.zh: 1 号线是红色的，也就是这根导线是红色的，

segments.text: Line 2 is of yellow color and line 3 is of blue color.
segments.zh: 2 号线是黄色的，3 号线是蓝色的，

segments.text: Which we call RYBB in short.
segments.zh: 我们简称为 RYBB。

segments.text: i.e. if there is a line of the three faces, then its color code is RYBB i.e. red, yellow, blue.
segments.zh: 也就是说，如果是三相的线，它的颜色代码就是 RYBB，也就是红、黄、蓝。

segments.text: Now let's talk about the color code of the neutral conductor.
segments.zh: 现在我们来讲讲中性导体的颜色代码。

segments.text: So the color code of the neutral conductor is black i.e. the wire of the black color.
segments.zh: 中性导体的颜色代码是黑色，也就是黑色的导线。

segments.text: Now let's talk about the protective conductor i.e. the line of the earth is of which color code is used.
segments.zh: 现在我们来讲讲保护导体，也就是地线用的是哪种颜色代码。

segments.text: So this is the green and yellow color.
segments.zh: 它是黄绿双色的，

segments.text: Like you can see it through the image here.
segments.zh: 就像你们在这张图里看到的那样。

segments.text: So in this way, the basic color code of the power cable is here, which is very important for you to know.
segments.zh: 所以这就是电力电缆的基本颜色代码，了解这些对你来说非常重要。
